verifications.claim: The first manned moon landing occurred on July 20, 1969.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: '20 July 1969—Astronaut Edwin E. Aldrin Jr... walks on the surface'; R2: 'at 4:17 p.m. the craft touched down... July 20'; R3: 'On July 20, 1969, humans walked on the Moon'; R4: 'Landing date July 20, 1969, 20:17:40 UTC'; R5: 'landed on the Sea of Tranquility on July 20, 1969'
verifications.reasoning: All references directly state or imply the landing date as July 20, 1969.

verifications.claim: The first manned moon landing occurred during NASA's Apollo 11 mission.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Apollo 11... crewed lunar landing'; R2: 'Apollo 11... moon landing'; R3: 'Apollo 11: The Moon Landing... first time'; R4: 'Apollo 11... first landed humans on the Moon'; R5: 'Apollo 11 was the first manned mission'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly identify Apollo 11 as the first manned moon landing mission.

verifications.claim: Astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin landed the Lunar Module Eagle at 20:17:40 UTC.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Lunar Module “Eagle”'; R2: 'at 4:17 p.m. the craft touched down... lunar module Eagle'; R4: 'Astronauts... Armstrong and Aldrin... LM Eagle, landing... 20:17:40 UTC'
verifications.reasoning: R4 directly states the exact time and module for Armstrong and Aldrin; R2 confirms time (4:17 p.m. EDT = 20:17 UTC) and Eagle.

verifications.claim: Neil Armstrong took his first step onto the moon's surface at 10:56 p.m. EDT.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'At 10:39 p.m.... Armstrong... down the module's ladder' (context first steps); R3: 'Armstrong... first human to walk... 10:56 p.m. EDT'; R4: 'Armstrong... first human to walk... at 02:56:15 UTC' (equiv. to 10:56 p.m. EDT July 20)
verifications.reasoning: R3 and R4 directly support the exact time and event for Armstrong's first step.

verifications.claim: The astronauts on NASA's Apollo 11 mission were Neil Armstrong (commander), Buzz Aldrin (lunar module pilot), and Michael Collins (command module pilot).
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Neil Armstrong... commander... Buzz Aldrin... lunar module pilot... Michael Collins... command module pilot'; R2: 'astronauts Neil Armstrong... Buzz Aldrin and Michael Collins'; R3: 'Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin... Michael Collins'; R4: 'Commander Neil Armstrong, Command Module Pilot Michael Collins, and Lunar Module Pilot Edwin "Buzz" Aldrin'; R5: 'Neil Armstrong, commander; Michael Collins, module pilot; Edwin E. "Buzz" Aldrin, lunar module pilot'
verifications.reasoning: All references confirm the exact crew and roles.

verifications.claim: Neil Armstrong became the first person to walk on the moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Neil Armstrong First human to set foot on the Moon'; R2: 'Armstrong... first one out'; R3: 'Neil Armstrong... became the first human to walk on the moon'; R4: 'Armstrong became the first human to walk on the Moon'; R5: 'Neil Armstrong was the first one out'
verifications.reasoning: All references explicitly state Armstrong was first to walk on the Moon.

verifications.claim: Buzz Aldrin walked on the moon after Neil Armstrong.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Neil Armstrong... Buzz Aldrin... on the Moon'; R3: 'Neil Armstrong exited... first... Buzz Aldrin'; R4: 'Armstrong... followed by Aldrin nineteen minutes later'
verifications.reasoning: References confirm Aldrin followed Armstrong onto the surface.

verifications.claim: The Apollo 11 landing site was the Sea of Tranquility.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'touched down on the southwestern edge of the Sea of Tranquility'; R3: 'The Apollo 11 Landing Site The Sea of Tranquility | Mare Tranquillitatis'; R4: 'landing in the Sea of Tranquility... Tranquility Base, Mare Tranquillitatis'; R5: 'landed on the Sea of Tranquility'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple references directly name Sea of Tranquility as the site.

verifications.claim: The Apollo 11 crew returned to Earth on July 24, 1969.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'SPLASHDOWN July 24, 1969'; R2: 'safely splashing down... on July 24'; R4: 'returned safely to Earth on July 24'

verifications.claim: The Apollo 11 crew splashed down in the Pacific Ocean.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'safely splashing down in the Pacific Ocean'; R4: 'splashing down in the Pacific Ocean... North Pacific Ocean'
verifications.reasoning: Both references explicitly state Pacific Ocean splashdown.

verifications.claim: An estimated 650 million people watched the Apollo 11 landing on television.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'As an estimated 650 million people watched'; R4: 'broadcast live to an estimated 600 million viewers'
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly matches 650 million; R4 close at 600 million, supporting high viewership estimate.
